evidenceSummary: November 4 source update implements monthly/annual native subscriptions and separate non-billing 14-day local trials in all seven existing apps, with expiration-aware writes and preserved reading/export/deletion/encrypted recovery. Real-store provisioning, signed purchase acceptance and physical-device qualification remain pending. Optional hosting reference/runtime and metadata verifier source now exist with local contracts; service installation and verifier deployment remain unqualified; optional consumer synchronization is implemented only for deliberately adopted apps. Earlier foundation evidence retains its original scope; the product release order and publication pause remain unchanged. Claim Crate remains consolidated into What We Own; 27 physical repositories remain. Subsequent implementation publishes generic typed product hosting and adopts it in Pantry Clock and Paws regular builds through one shared session engine, with real Rust/TLS/MLS tests. Core foundation pins remain unchanged; live licensing, service deployment and physical/store release qualification remain pending.
